1.explanation: The meristematic zone (region of cell division) is located just above the root cap and contains actively dividing cells responsible for root growth in length. Why others are incorrect: (A) Region of maturation is where root hairs develop and absorption occurs. (B) Region of elongation is where cells elongate but do not divide. (D) Root hair zone is part of the maturation region. NCERT concept: Regions of root.

3.explanation: In a fibrous root system, the primary root is short-lived and is replaced by a large number of roots originating from the base of the stem. Why others are incorrect: (A) Tap root system has a persistent primary root. (C) Adventitious roots arise from parts other than the radicle but the description specifically matches fibrous roots. (D) Stilt roots are a type of adventitious root modification. NCERT concept: Types of root systems.
